items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, I think it was Huck and...

ctx.x: Yes. Had these beautiful new uniforms and they were making pictures that night of the band because the band was going to do some big gig. And Louis Metcalf was in that band.
No, I think it was Huck and...
Was that the guy that told me that his wife had better not tell him when he's wrong?
